title: Tirisfal Glades
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Faranell
lines.text: Anya, we’ve been expecting you. Putress sent us the list of reagents he requires.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: How thoughtful of him. I trust things are going well here?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Faranell
lines.text: Well enough. Though I do long for the comforts of my laboratory.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Melisara
lines.text: Anya, that idiot Gordo has gone missing again. Drag him back to camp if you find him, will you?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’ll keep our eyes open. Dark Lady watch over you.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Hey! We could use some help here! We’d make it worth your while!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Hmm. Go on.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: We got ambushed by gnolls and had to abandon our inventory. If you get it back for us, we’ll give you a quarter of our stock.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Make it half or we walk away.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Half?! That’s highway robbery!
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Half?! That’s highway robbery![/"Surprised"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Well... we've already been robbed once today. All right, deal.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Hey, you did it! And our merchandise is still intact!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Indeed. Now, about our payment.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Of course! We’d be glad to personally transport your half of the supplies to your, uh, Undercity, was it?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: What better way to show our appreciation to our new customers--I mean--gracious hosts?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You sneaky little--
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You sneaky little--[/"Angry"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Whoa! You get your own payment for services rendered, of course! A small token of our gratitude!
lines.raw: ["Scared" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Whoa! You get your own payment for services rendered, of course! A small token of our gratitude![/"Scared"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Which we graciously accept. The Forsaken will benefit from your wares. See you in the city.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Anya Load Into Map First Comment
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: There's a Dark Ranger camp ahead. Let's check in with them first.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 01
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Anya, how did I end up in Putress’s apothecarium to begin with?

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 01
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You were among the Scourge forces that held the Capital City when Lady Sylvanas came to claim it.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 01
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: After the battle, we gathered the remaining undead and sent them to Putress for... processing.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 02
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: So I fought against Sylvanas when I was in the Scourge? And yet she welcomes me as one of the Forsaken?

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 02
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: She understands all too well what it means to be forced to do the Lich King’s bidding.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 02
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: How could she turn away a newly awakened Forsaken, no matter what they had done before?

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 03
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What about you, Anya? How did you join the Forsaken?

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 03
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: In life, I served under Sylvanas. We both died defending our kingdom against the Scourge. And we were both raised into undeath.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 03
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: When I regained my free will, the Dark Lady offered me a place to belong. And for that, she has my eternal loyalty.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 04
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Do you remember what you were forced to do when you were under the Lich King’s control?

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 04
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Yes. But I will not discuss it, Garek. Not with you, nor with anyone else.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 04
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Reliving the past will not change it. Better to move forward without looking back.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 05
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It seems many of the Forsaken have stories like yours. Cursed with undeath, seeking to make the most of a grim fate.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 05
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We are indeed united by our torment. The world sees us as monsters, and so we have only each other to rely upon.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Looting Darkhound Blood 05
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then I will endeavor to be reliable. For Lady Sylvanas, and for the Forsaken.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Glix Comment After Cinematic 02
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: The gnoll camp is to the south of here. Don’t die! Again.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Comment On Glix After Cinematic 03
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’re simply going to let them set up shop in the Undercity?

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Comment On Glix After Cinematic 03
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Forsaken need supplies, which the goblins can provide. And if they’re reliant on the Undercity for protection...

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Comment On Glix After Cinematic 03
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then the Dark Lady can negotiate their prices from a position of strength. Impressive, Bandarion.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Anya Looting Broodmother Venom
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: As one of the Forsaken, you may develop an affinity for spiders. But it would still be wise to approach them with caution.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Anya Gordo Found
lines.speaker: Gordo
lines.text: Sticky webs! Gordo needs help!

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Anya Gordo Found
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Yet another fine mess, Gordo!

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Anya Gordo Freed
lines.speaker: Gordo
lines.text: Gordo free! Going back to camp now!

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Anya Gordo Freed
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Try not to wander off again.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Plagued Bears Defeated
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A vile sickness festers throughout these woods.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Plagued Bears Defeated
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scourge's handiwork. They sought to blight all of Lordaeron.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Garek Anya Plagued Bears Defeated
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Now this land belongs to the Forsaken. We suffer neither the Scourge nor the living to intrude.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Anya Looting First Murloc Scale
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Murlocs. Foul creatures, but their scales are useful in alchemy.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Anya Looting All Reagents Collected
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That’s everything Putress wants. Let’s head back to the Undercity.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.First Visit.Melisara Return Quest Completed
lines.speaker: Melisara
lines.text: Gordo collected a few goods while he was wandering out there. They might be worth a look.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Anya Load Into Map Quarry Location
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The quarry is on the northern edge of the woods. Let’s move.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Garek Anya Comment On Bernd
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s fortunate that Bernd remembers masonry from when he was alive. His skills will benefit the Undercity.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Garek Anya Comment On Bernd
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: One might say that there is value to be found in our former lives after all.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Garek Anya Comment On Bernd
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Hmph. You speak quite knowingly about such things, for one who awakened so recently.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Garek Anya Comment On Bernd
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Yes, well. It’s like you said. I do catch on quickly, don’t I?

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Garek Anya Approach Quarry
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Looks like the ogres have set up some fortifications.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Garek Anya Approach Quarry
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then we have a choice to make. Either we attack head on, or we look for another way in.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Garek Anya Ogre Lord Dead
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: With their leader slain, the rest of the ogres will scatter into the hills.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Garek Anya Ogre Lord Dead
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s good to know that this quarry will supply Bernd’s workforce.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Bandit Leader Found
lines.speaker: Bandit Lord
lines.text: The undead! Cut them apart and take their valuables!

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Anya Bandit Leader Dead
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Well, these look like the parts Keever asked us to collect.

lines.scene: Cinematics.Cinematic 04 Ghoul Found.Cinematic 04 Ghoul Found
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That ghoul appears to be fishing. I’ve never seen that before.

lines.scene: Cinematics.Cinematic 04 Ghoul Found.Cinematic 04 Ghoul Found
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Quickly, after them!

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Anya Ghoul Captured
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I suppose that’s one way to catch a fish. Let’s bring this ghoul back to Keever.

lines.scene: Map Events.Gameplay Dialogues.Second Visit.Anya Ghoul Faints
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Looks like the ghoul survived the fight. Let’s bring it back to Keever.

lines.scene: Map Events.Main Quest 02 Secure Quarry.Ogre Taunt
lines.speaker: Gokrus
lines.text: Me smash you!
